sections.name: About Us
sections.copy:
Welcome to DIKE JOHN OIL & TEXTILES

Situated at 2/4 Onyenso Street Off 45 Omenazu by Faulks Road, Aba North, we are your one-stop destination for premium textiles and quality oils for fashion and creative design.

With years of experience serving Aba's vibrant fashion community, we understand the needs of designers, tailors, and creative professionals. Our extensive collection includes the finest ankara, lace, george wrapper, senator materials, and specialized oils for fabric treatment and finishing.

We pride ourselves on competitive pricing, authentic materials, and personalized service that keeps our customers coming back. Whether you're a fashion designer working on a bridal collection or a tailor serving everyday clients, we have exactly what you need to bring your creative vision to life.

sections.name: Our Products & Services
sections.copy:
Quality Materials for Every Creative Project

Premium Textiles
We stock an extensive range of high-quality fabrics including ankara, lace, george wrapper, senator materials, silk, cotton, and brocade. All materials are carefully sourced to ensure authenticity and durability.

Fashion Oils & Treatments
Specialized oils for fabric treatment, finishing, and enhancement. Perfect for achieving that premium look and feel your clients demand.

Bulk Supply
Competitive wholesale pricing for fashion houses, tailoring shops, and bulk buyers. We support businesses with reliable supply and flexible payment options.

Expert Consultation
Not sure which material suits your design? Our experienced team provides free consultation to help you select the perfect fabrics for any project.

Custom Orders
Need something specific? We can source special materials and colors to match your exact requirements.
